run.title: Plan 03 — Migrate the workspace to TypeScript 7 (stable)

commit.subject: build(deps): migrate the workspace to TypeScript 7
commit.body:
Bump the root typescript dependency from ^6.0.3 to ^7 (the stable, GA native
compiler, which keeps the `tsc` binary name). All three units continue to
type-check with `tsc -b` — now backed by the native TypeScript 7 compiler —
with no tsconfig or source change. The shared tsconfig.base.json uses none of
the options TS7 removed, so no ignoreDeprecations shim is needed. Verified by the
full gate (typecheck across all units, tests, manifest validation, db:generate).
Docs updated to record the TypeScript 7 toolchain.

phases.title: Bump the workspace to TypeScript 7 and verify parity
